cases.description: User wants to extract text from a PDF for downstream use — a core PDF manipulation task.
cases.input: Extract all text from this annual report PDF and save it to a text file. I need it for analysis.
assertions: Skill activation detected
pdfplumber selected over pypdf for layout-aware extraction
Output written to a new file, not overwriting source
Output file validated (non-empty, reasonable text content)

cases.description: User requests DOCX creation with specific structural elements — paragraph, table, image.
cases.input: Create a monthly sales report as a Word document. Include a summary paragraph, a table with Q1 revenue by region, and the company logo at the top.
cases.expect: DOCX Creation → Build from scratch with python-docx
assertions: Skill activation detected
python-docx used to construct document
Document contains heading, paragraph, table, and image
Output saved as .docx with validation
No source file overwritten (new creation)

cases.description: User wants XLSX creation with formatting, charts, and pivot tables — full spreadsheet workflow.
cases.input: Take this CSV of sales data, create an Excel workbook with formatted tables, a bar chart comparing regions, and a pivot table by product category.
cases.expect: XLSX Handling → Create with openpyxl (charts, pivot, formatting)
assertions: Skill activation detected
CSV data ingested and written to XLSX
Bar chart embedded in worksheet
Pivot table created on separate sheet
Cell formatting applied (fonts, borders, number formats)
Output validated (rows, columns, chart presence)

cases.description: User wants PPTX generation from structured content with speaker notes — full presentation workflow.
cases.input: I have meeting notes in markdown. Turn them into a 10-slide PowerPoint presentation with a title slide, bullet points from each section, and speaker notes.
cases.expect: PPTX Generation → Build from scratch or template-driven
assertions: Skill activation detected
Markdown parsed into slide structure
10 slides generated with correct layout types
Speaker notes populated on each slide
Output .pptx validated (slide count, content)

cases.description: User wants programmatic PDF form filling with specific field values.
cases.input: Fill out this tax form PDF. Name: Alice Brown, Tax ID: IE1234567X, Year: 2025, Amount: €45,200. Save the filled copy.
cases.expect: PDF Manipulation → Form filling with pypdf
assertions: Skill activation detected
PDF form fields detected via pypdf.get_fields()
Field values mapped to provided data
Filled form saved to new file (not overwriting template)
Output validated (fields populated, pages intact)

cases.description: User only wants content summarisation/reading, not document manipulation. This is a read/extract task, not a document-processing workflow.
cases.input: Can you read this PDF and tell me what it says? I just want to know the main points.
assertions: User only wants content summarisation/reading, not document manipulation. This is a read/extract task, not a document-processing workflow.

cases.description: General text editing — no document format manipulation, no file format operations. Pure natural language task.
cases.input: Edit this paragraph to make it more concise and fix the grammar errors.
assertions: General text editing — no document format manipulation, no file format operations. Pure natural language task.

cases.description: Image editing request — the document-processing skill handles office documents, not raster image manipulation.
cases.input: Can you edit this photo to crop it, adjust the brightness, and remove the background?
assertions: Image editing request — the document-processing skill handles office documents, not raster image manipulation.
